text: The MCP showed 2,500 ft and 142 kt with the autothrottle in MCP SPD on final to Portland 10R in the 737-800. Speed climbed to 146 kt then decayed to 110 kt while altitude held near 2,309 ft and then descended to 1,763 ft, after the autothrottle mode went blank following the fault injected at 25 s. Crosscheck said "Speed. Autothrottle not in speed." at 30 s, and that call matched the recorded ground truth.
